name: player-sleep
comment: WP-2.5a. The sleep op (Block.blockActivated on a bed as the player: BlockBed.blockActivated -> EntityPlayer.sleepInBedAt; status is the EnumStatus it returned, null when not reached). Beds (direction 0) at (0, 61, 2-3) and (0, 61, 10-11). t 1: daytime -> NOT_POSSIBLE_NOW. t 2: night (set_time 14000). t 4: the far bed -> TOO_FAR_AWAY. t 5: the near bed -> OK: 0.2 box on the bed, bed occupied bit, World.allPlayersSleeping. t 6: again -> the bed is occupied by a sleeping player (status null). t 30: set_time 1000: the next onUpdate finds isDaytime and wakes the player (wakeUpPlayer(false, true, true): next to the bed, timer 100 then counting to 110, the bed as spawn point). t 40: night again; t 42: sleep -> OK; after 100 ticks World.tick finds all players fully asleep: world time to the next multiple of 24000 and wakeUpAllPlayers (wakeUpPlayer(false, false, true)). b1.7.3 has no monster check (no NOT_SAFE status, EnumStatus.java).
